Text: Allahu Akbar. Allahu Akbar.
Speaker: Dr. Rashad Khalifa
Description: In this sermon, Dr. Rashad Khalifa argues that idol worship of figures such as Muhammad, Jesus, Mary, or various saints stems from a failure to grasp the true greatness of God. He walks through a series of astronomical scales, the solar system, the Milky Way galaxy, the neighboring galaxy, and the broader universe, to illustrate how insignificant the Earth is by comparison. He then presents the Quran's claim, which he says is confirmed by its mathematical code, that this universe is the smallest of seven nested universes held in God's hand as described in Quran 39:67, and uses the precise orbital mechanics of the moon and sun as further evidence of God's power, concluding that no human being could share in such greatness.
